crossRefs.note: “This is the statute of the law which Yahweh has commanded. Tell the children of Israel to bring you a red heifer…
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
“Come to me, all you who labor and are heavily burdened, and I will give you rest.
And being found in human form, he humbled himself, becoming obedient to the point of death, yes, the death of the cross.

translations.web: It shall be that the elders of the city which is nearest to the slain man shall take a heifer of the herd, which hasn’t been worked with and which has not drawn in the yoke.
translations.bsb: Then the elders of the city nearest the victim shall take a heifer that has never been yoked or used for work,
translations.kjv: And it shall be, that the city which is next unto the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take an heifer, which hath not been wrought with, and which hath not drawn in the yoke;
translations.asv: and it shall be, that the city which is nearest unto the slain man, even the elders of that city shall take a heifer of the herd, which hath not been wrought with, and which hath not drawn in the yoke;
